object.attr: derived: link targets and object IDs come from other clones and from agents; reading outside the repository discloses files, and on Windows a UNC path offers the user's credentials to another host (CF-T1). A real prohibition. Accepted on 2026-11-10 as a security fix, because the scan of a cloned repository already opened such paths (confirmed in the code); to confirm with the person (open question Q11).
object.description: Mellon shall not open a file or folder outside the repository to work out a link's state, incoming links, a trace, a coverage report or a review of a suspect link.
